pr.title: fix(vercel): Fix ISR path rewrite to prevent 404
pr.body: Fix a bug which prevented pages from being served by ISR by the vercel adapter. PR #15959 introduced a bug with the vercel adaptor which made any route served by ISR result in a 404, due to how vercel ISR works (request path must be changed when serving an ISR path). No test cases added; manual e2e on a Vercel project. No docs needed.

intent.summary: Restore ISR routes on the Vercel adapter after #15959 made them 404: entrypoint.ts now also reads the real path from the x_astro_path query param when the request carries x-vercel-isr: 1 and no valid middleware secret.
